name: shipready
description: Generate production-grade, deploy-ready apps from a single sentence. No prototypes. No placeholders. No TODOs. Complete codebases only — security, database, error handling, API design, environment, performance, frontend, and DevOps baked in from line one.
author: Anubhav

commands.name: /shipready
commands.description: Generate a production-grade app from a description
examples: /shipready restaurant booking app with admin panel and email confirmations
/shipready SaaS waitlist with email capture and referral tracking
/shipready personal finance tracker with budget alerts and charts
/shipready multi-tenant project management tool like Trello
/shipready e-commerce store with Stripe checkout and order tracking

capabilities: Generates complete Next.js 14 + Prisma + PostgreSQL TypeScript applications
Bakes in all 8 production dimensions from line one: Security, Database, Error Handling, API Design, Environment, Performance, Frontend, DevOps
Creates Dockerfile + docker-compose.yml with health checks and multi-stage builds
Generates comprehensive README with exact copy-paste setup commands
Produces SHIPREADY.md audit report with detailed Ship Score (X/100)
Sets up authentication with NextAuth.js (email/password + OAuth)
Configures structured logging with Pino and environment validation with Zod
Implements rate limiting with Upstash Redis
Creates full CRUD API routes with consistent error responses
Generates complete frontend pages with loading, error, and empty states
No prototypes, no placeholders, no TODOs - only production-ready code
Includes seed data with admin and regular user accounts

outputs.project_structure: Complete Next.js 14 App Router project with TypeScript
outputs.database: Prisma schema with migrations, seed data, and singleton client
outputs.api: RESTful API with versioning (v1), pagination, and consistent response shapes
outputs.auth: NextAuth.js with credentials provider and JWT sessions
outputs.frontend: Tailwind CSS with dark mode, shadcn/ui components, and form validation
outputs.docs: README.md with setup guide and SHIPREADY.md audit report
outputs.validation: Zod schemas for all inputs with type safety
outputs.middleware: Authentication, security headers, and CORS configuration

features: No stack traces exposed in production
Foreign keys with explicit onDelete behavior

installation.manual: mkdir my-app && cd my-app && npm init -y

quick_start.example: /shipready personal finance tracker with budget alerts and charts

prohibitions: No hardcoded secrets, URLs, or credentials
No Math.random() or Date.now() for IDs
No loading entire tables into memory

default_decisions.logging: Pino with debug in dev, info in production

version_history.1.0.0: Initial release - Complete Generation Mode with 8 production dimensions
